clusters.notes: Set 005 of 5. The two carriers compute identical results for all inputs (verified by equivalence_test.php). Carrier A uses traditional foreach-loop accumulation; carrier B uses array_reduce with an anonymous function accumulator — both compute subtotal, discount, tax, shipping, total, and item count. The benchmark showed jscpd (token-based) finds this pair with recall 1.0 because they share many normalized tokens (variable names, operators, literals). AST-based and semantic detectors can also detect it. Token-based detection is TRUE for this set (not false as typical L7) because the foreach and array_reduce idioms share sufficient lexical similarity. SEED LIMITATION: invoice_totals has only one API-01 variant, so this set has 2 carriers (foreach + array_reduce) instead of the ideal 3 with three distinct idioms.
